responsibility: Declares a gm2 ISO-library extension that exposes contiguous memory buffers as IOChan channels. It defines open-for-write and open-for-read entry points with buffer/length/used tracking, close and reposition operations for rereading or rewriting from the start, and a predicate to test whether a channel is a memory stream device.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the MemStream pair, exposing only the memory-stream channel operations such as OpenRead/OpenWrite, Close, Rewrite, Reread, and IsMem; the companion MemStream.mod contains the device-id allocation, RTdata-backed per-channel MemInfo state, and generic-device callback wiring that make those operations work.
